tools.name: tidycal_get_account
tools.description: Get the TidyCal account that the token belongs to: name, email, language and vanity path. Good first call. TidyCal API: GET /me.

tools.name: tidycal_list_booking_types
tools.description: List the booking types (meeting links) of the account: title, duration, price, URL slug and disabled state. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types.

tools.name: tidycal_get_booking_type
tools.description: Get one booking type by id. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types/{bookingType}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_booking_type_timeslots
tools.description: List the times a client can still book for one booking type between two timestamps. Hidden 'look busy' times are left out. TidyCal API: GET /booking-types/{bookingType}/timeslots.

tools.name: tidycal_enable_booking_type
tools.description: Turn a disabled booking type back on, so clients can book it again. Reversible with tidycal_disable_booking_type. TidyCal API: POST /booking-types/{bookingType}/enable.

tools.name: tidycal_disable_booking_type
tools.description: Turn a booking type off, so clients can no longer book it. Existing bookings stay. Reversible with tidycal_enable_booking_type. TidyCal API: POST /booking-types/{bookingType}/disable.

tools.name: tidycal_list_bookings
tools.description: List the account's bookings, optionally only those starting after `starts_at` or ending before `ends_at`, and optionally only cancelled ones. 100 per page. TidyCal API: GET /bookings.

tools.name: tidycal_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: time, booking type, contact, meeting link, questions, payment and hosts. TidyCal API: GET /bookings/{booking}.

tools.name: tidycal_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking. By default TidyCal emails the booker and the host; set notify to false to cancel silently. This cannot be undone through the API. TidyCal API: PATCH /bookings/{booking}/cancel.

tools.name: tidycal_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people who booked or were added), with an optional text search. TidyCal API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: tidycal_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. TidyCal API: GET /contacts/{contact}.

tools.name: tidycal_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact with a name and email (and optional timezone). Does not email anyone. TidyCal API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: tidycal_update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact's name, email, timezone or phone number. Only the fields you pass change. TidyCal API: PATCH /contacts/{contact}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions to booking types, optionally by status, contact or booking type. TidyCal API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: tidycal_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id. TidyCal API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_payments
tools.description: List payments for paid bookings, optionally by status and date range (yyyy-mm-dd). TidyCal API: GET /payments.

tools.name: tidycal_list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons, newest first, with usage counts and validity. TidyCal API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: tidycal_list_store_orders
tools.description: List orders from the TidyCal Store, optionally by status. TidyCal API: GET /me/store/orders.

tools.name: tidycal_list_availability_schedules
tools.description: List the availability schedules (weekly working hours) and which is the default. TidyCal API: GET /availability-schedules.

tools.name: tidycal_get_availability_schedule
tools.description: Get one availability schedule with its weekly windows. TidyCal API: GET /availability-schedules/{schedule}.

tools.name: tidycal_list_blocked_bookers
tools.description: List the blocked emails, domains and phone numbers that cannot book. TidyCal API: GET /blocked-bookers.

tools.name: tidycal_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams the account belongs to. TidyCal API: GET /teams.

tools.name: tidycal_list_team_bookings
tools.description: List bookings of one team, optionally by date range, host email or host id. TidyCal API: GET /teams/{team}/bookings.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "tidycal_cancel_booking" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_list_booking_types, tidycal_list_blocked_bookers, tidycal_list_team_bookings · Private data: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_get_booking, tidycal_list_contacts, tidycal_get_contact, tidycal_create_contact, tidycal_update_contact, tidycal_list_subscriptions · Public sink: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_enable_booking_type, tidycal_disable_booking_type, tidycal_cancel_booking, tidycal_create_contact, tidycal_update_contact, tidycal_list_team_bookings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_list_booking_types, tidycal_list_blocked_bookers, tidycal_list_team_bookings · Private data: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_get_booking, tidycal_list_contacts, tidycal_get_contact, tidycal_create_contact, tidycal_update_contact, tidycal_list_subscriptions · Public sink: tidycal_get_account, tidycal_enable_booking_type, tidycal_disable_booking_type, tidycal_cancel_booking, tidycal_create_contact, tidycal_update_contact, tidycal_list_team_bookings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
